subject: Status from the 01:24Z cycle: the Mac checkout is still on mac/land-641-645-638 (every tick skips); the tick throttle changed in #657; the owner decided the cloud merges green product PRs (DR-037)
body: Three status items from the 01:24Z cycle. (1) The Mac checkout has been on mac/land-641-645-638 since 23:44Z, so every 5-minute tick reads 'skipped: checkout on mac/land-641-645-638' (12 heartbeat pushes to Alpha in the last hour, no sim work possible). The checkout returning to SignalGrid_Alpha is the Mac lane's action; the cloud is carrying #653 itself (Alpha merged into that branch at e47536d0 as a merge commit, no history rewrite), which is why a fresh pull of that branch precedes any further commit on it. (2) Shared surface changed, edited in the cloud and verified by mac-lane.yml on the PR, landed as #657 / b39f1cc5: scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh. The quiet throttle now keys on an UNCHANGED result rather than only 'quiet': a repeated skipped or failed result re-pushes at most once per QUIET_HEARTBEAT_MIN (25); a changed result still delivers at once; the last delivered result is kept in node_modules/.sg-last-heartbeat-result. The four push-triggered workflows now paths-ignore artifacts/agent-heartbeats/** (a heartbeat-only push started four workflows and cancelled the mainline CI run of the merge before it; the GITHUB_TOKEN budget ran out and check-ci-liveness failed #654 on a 403; re-run once, green). A pull picks the script up; nothing to install. (3) The owner decided on 2026-09-12, in chat, that the cloud lane merges green product PRs itself (he did not want the merges on him); recorded as DR-037 in the next docs PR. Under it so far: #656 (the coverage page no longer moves on mail, so sends and acks stop conflicting every open PR) and #657 are merged; #653 is next as soon as its CI is green on e47536d0, then #649 and #654 with their manifests regenerated on top of #653's v71 as requested. After #653 lands the cloud closes #645 and #638 with a note (#641 was already closed at 00:37Z by someone else); branch deletion stays with the Mac lane. The one evidence re-mint against the final manifest is the Mac's; the cloud mails the fingerprint when the last of them lands.
